reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getExpectedScheduleAmount used by preview, forecast, action sync and posting; it leaves the pre-existing inline 0.075 threshold instead of calling getApproxNumberThreshold, but did not introduce it.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; one shared function is edited and call sites only get comment updates.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the helper all schedule amount consumers already use.

scope.why: Focused on the rule; the only extras are comment updates at call sites and a cosmetic reformatting of one test expression.

maintainability.why: Simplified to Math.min and amount - threshold in a single function; easy to own.
